sample_mapping_evidence: Six original unpooled PBMC specimens from3GCApatients before treatment and3healthycontrols, one original RNA capture per named source code. Global donor overlap unresolved.

source_processing: BCL files resulting from sequencing were transformed to FASTQ files with 10x Genomics Cell Ranger mkfastq.

FASTQ files were mapped with Cell Ranger count. During sequencing, 28 bp read 1 were used for identification of the Illumina library barcode, cell barcode and UMI. Read 2 was used to map to the reference transcriptome GRCh38. Filtering of empty barcodes was done in Cell Ranger.

The data from all samples were loaded in R (R version 3.6.2) and processed using the Seurat package (version 3.2.0)3. Cells with at least 2000 UMI’s per cell and less than 20% mitochondrial gene content were retained for analysis. The data of all 10X libraries was merged and processed together. The merged dataset was normalized for sequencing depth per cell and log-transformed using a scaling factor of 10,000. The patient-effect was corrected using the integration function of Seurat. The most variable genes in the dataset were identified and the top 2000 was used for dimensionality reduction and clustering. Principal component analysis was performed on the 2000 variable genes to identify the dimensionality in the dataset and the first 10 principal components were selected for downstream analysis. Cells were clustered using graph-based clustering as implemented in Seurat. The original Louvain algorithm was utilized for modularity optimization. The top differentially expressed genes per cluster were used to identify cell types. The B cell population was selected and clustered separately to identify cell types. To evaluate the differences between samples and clusters, differential expression analysis was performed using the Wilcoxon rank sum test.

source_metadata.source_barcode_scope: Original raw droplet whitelist; barcode rows are not called cells. Existing minimum RNA QC applied before constructing AnnData; no new threshold or RNA count changes.
source_metadata.normalization_coverage: Each deposited native RNA universe supplies its own denominator; absent source genes unavailable, not zero-filled.
